Drumroll 🥁 for April’s member of the month: Alejandro Vera! 🥳
Alejandro is a senior in Computer Science here at FIU and was an INIT Build Lead!!!

🔍 About Alejandro:
“Hi there! I'm Alejandro, a senior student at Florida International University pursuing a Bachelor degree in Computer Science (Fall '24). I am extremely passionate about Software Engineering and I was the team lead for Web Dev 1 at INIT FIU. I am also extremely excited to be an incoming SDE intern at Amazon for the summer of 2024! My journey in computer science started my senior year of high school (2021) where I started studying HTML/CSS and JavaScript out of pure curiosity and love for coding.”

🚀 Alejandro’s Proudest Achievement:
“My proudest accomplishment so far in my career has been getting my most recent internship at Amazon for a Software Development role. Getting the chance to work at a company that I absolutely adore while doing work that I am extremely devoted to is currently the accomplishment I am most proud of.” 🌐💼 

Alejandro describes his process in applying to Amazon: 
“Some key steps that I took to receive this offer is by studying technical problems via LeetCode, studying on how to succeed in a behavioral interview, and just being myself! Really showing your love for not only programming but for the company goes a long way and I believe the recruiters were able to capture that from me.”

🌎 Interests/Hobbies:
For hobbies I love running, playing basketball, playing video games, going out with friends, and traveling!

🎓 Alejandro’s Words of Wisdom:
“My strongest piece of advice for students would be to have passion. Having passion for what you want to achieve is the greatest motivator on the journey to achieving your goals and dreams. Have the passion to be involved in extremely helpful organization like INIT, have the passion to research your goals outside of the classroom, and have the passion to push your limits and embrace challenges along the way. Oh, and LeetCode for the programmers :D”

🚗 Team Draura brought driver safety to life at ShellHacks 2025 using Google Cloud’s ADK and Gemini!  After witnessing a serious crash on their way to the event, the team set out to rethink how people learn to drive safely. Draura is a 3D driving simulation that blends real Google Maps data with retro Game Boy-style visuals, letting players navigate real streets, face real hazards, and answer safety questions in real time.  Powered by multi-agent systems built with Google ADK, the game’s AI agents generate dynamic, location-aware scenarios and questions based on real-world traffic data. It’s educational, immersive, and surprisingly fun — turning serious safety training into an engaging experience.  Interested in building with Google Cloud ADK / A2A?
